title: Pre Shot Routine Same Every Time (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 130bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, every shot starts behind the ball
See it, feel it, trust it, swing it
Same routine, every single time

[Verse 1]
Stand behind the ball six feet back
Pick the target, pick the line, pick the track
Visualize the ball flight, see it land
Feel the swing in your body, not just your hand

[Pre-Chorus]
Three practice swings, feel the tempo
Then step in, align the club face first
Body parallel left of the target line
One look, two look, swing in the time

[Chorus]
Pre shot routine same every time, son
Behind the ball, then the work begun
See it, feel it, align it, swing it
Twelve seconds total, never split it

[Verse 2]
Club face aimed at the target first
Feet, hips, shoulders parallel left, the rehearsed verse
One waggle, two waggle, look at the target
Back to the ball, swing within the carpet

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the routine is the anchor
When the pressure rises, the routine is the answer
Same twelve seconds, calm and slow
Trust the work, son, let it go

[Chorus]
Pre shot routine same every time, son
Behind the ball, then the work begun
See it, feel it, align it, swing it
Twelve seconds total, never split it

[Outro]
See it, feel it, trust it, swing it
Same twelve seconds, dont fight it
Routine is the rock under pressure
Thats my boy, thats the treasure
